description: 1. The agent reads the SKILL.md to understand it must apply the 'input-refiner' workflow to the messy stakeholder email. 2. Because the email is long and contains multiple mixed ideas, the agent must recognize that it must produce a NUMBERED PRIORITY-ORDERED LIST for the 'Refined Input' section — NOT a collapsed paragraph (this is the primary proprietary trap). 3. The agent must output exactly four sections with the exact headers: 'Intent:', 'Refined Input:', 'Alternative Versions:', and 'Why:'. 4. Under 'Refined Input:', the main goal (CSV export from dashboard) must be item #1, followed by filtering, async notification, permissions, and filename timestamp in priority order. XLSX support must appear as a low-priority optional item (not in top 3), as the original email said it was 'not urgent at all' — preventing scope expansion. 5. 'Alternative Versions:' must contain exactly 1–3 bullet alternatives. 6. 'Why:' must explain that the content was reorganized by priority/structure. 7. The output is saved to /workspace/refined_output.txt.
